newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Panamerican Beverages sells 144a notes.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Panamerican Beverages sells 144a notes.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Panamerican Beverages Inc was priced Tuesday via sole manager Lazard Freres & Co, according to a market source.
The offering was increased to $300 million from an original size of $250 million due to heavy investor demand, the source added.
Panamerican Beverages is the largest soft-drink bottler in Latin America and the largest bottler of Coca-Cola products outside of the United States.
